scopeDisclaimer: This capability inventory is a curated, source-backed reference of verified capabilities across consumer apps, paid subscriptions, related tools, underlying models, business workspaces, and developer APIs as of 2026-11-08. It is not an exhaustive list of every minor setting or regional experiment. Unconfirmed features are marked 'Not verified' rather than inferred as 'No'.

categories.title: Writing
categories.summary: Document drafting workspaces, tone customisation, and structured presentation generation.

categories.title: Research

categories.title: Coding
categories.summary: Interactive UI previews, terminal and repository coding agents, and sandboxed code execution.

categories.title: Documents and data
categories.summary: Model context window limits, persistent project knowledge bases, and spreadsheet/chart analysis.

categories.title: Images and media
categories.summary: Photorealistic raster image generation, multimodal visual inspection, and vector/motion design.

categories.title: Voice
categories.summary: Real-time spoken dialogue across mobile, desktop, and web applications.

categories.title: Integrations and automation
categories.summary: Cloud app connectors, browser/office add-ons, scheduled tasks, and developer APIs.

categories.title: Business, privacy and security

capabilities.featureName: Side-by-Side Document & Prose Editor (Canvas vs Artifacts & Claude Docs)
capabilities.whatItDoes: Opens a dedicated editing pane alongside the chat to draft, revise, and format long-form writing without losing conversation context.

chatgpt.requiredPlan: Free, Go, Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise
chatgpt.availabilityAndLimitations: Supports inline paragraph highlighting, targeted rewrites, reading-level and length sliders, and document export.

claude.requiredPlan: Free, Pro, Max, Ultra, Team, Enterprise
claude.availabilityAndLimitations: Renders formatted Markdown and structured documents in a side-by-side pane with version history; subject to rolling 5-hour session limits.

capabilities.featureName: Custom Writing Styles, Instructions & Cross-Chat Memory
capabilities.whatItDoes: Applies saved tone presets, formatting rules, and remembered user context automatically across conversations.

chatgpt.requiredPlan: Free, Go, Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise
chatgpt.availabilityAndLimitations: Includes account-wide Custom Instructions, cross-conversation Memory, and project-specific instructions inside Projects and Custom GPTs.

claude.requiredPlan: Free, Pro, Max, Ultra, Team, Enterprise
claude.availabilityAndLimitations: Includes configurable writing Styles, user preferences, and memory across conversations on web, desktop, and mobile.

capabilities.featureName: Presentation & Slide Deck Creation (Claude Slides vs Python File Export)
capabilities.whatItDoes: Generates structured presentation slide decks and visual layouts from outlines or source documents.

chatgpt.requiredPlan: Free (limited), Go, Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise
chatgpt.availabilityAndLimitations: Can generate downloadable PowerPoint (.pptx) files via Python scripts, but does not offer a dedicated interactive slide-deck canvas in the consumer app.

claude.requiredPlan: Free, Pro, Max, Ultra, Team, Enterprise
claude.availabilityAndLimitations: Official plan matrix includes Claude Slides and Claude Design across all consumer and workspace tiers, subject to plan usage limits.

capabilities.featureName: Real-Time Web Search with Inline Source Citations
capabilities.whatItDoes: Retrieves live information from the web and attaches verifiable links to cited sources.

chatgpt.requiredPlan: Free, Go, Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise
chatgpt.availabilityAndLimitations: Triggers automatically on timely queries or manually via the Search toggle, returning inline links and a collapsible sources sidebar.

claude.requiredPlan: Free, Pro, Max, Ultra, Team, Enterprise
claude.availabilityAndLimitations: Included across Free and paid plans with inline source citations; admins can manage web access on Team and Enterprise workspaces.

capabilities.featureName: Autonomous Multi-Step Research Reports (Deep Research vs Claude Research)
capabilities.whatItDoes: Executes multi-step searches across web pages and connected workspace documents to produce a synthesised report.

chatgpt.requiredPlan: Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise (tiered monthly query quotas)
chatgpt.availabilityAndLimitations: Performs multi-minute autonomous web browsing and synthesis with full source citations; monthly report allowances depend on plan tier.

claude.requiredPlan: Pro, Max, Ultra, Team, Enterprise (not offered on Free)
claude.availabilityAndLimitations: Synthesises findings across live web sources and connected workspace files; excluded from the Free tier on Anthropic's plan matrix.

capabilities.featureName: Dedicated Scientific Research Surface (Claude Science)
capabilities.whatItDoes: Provides a specialized product surface tailored for scientific literature review, hypothesis testing, and technical analysis.

chatgpt.requiredPlan: Not applicable as a separate named surface (reasoning models included on Plus/Pro/Business/Enterprise)
chatgpt.availabilityAndLimitations: OpenAI handles scientific reasoning through general GPT reasoning models and Deep Research rather than a separate named 'Science' product surface.

claude.requiredPlan: Pro, Max, Ultra, Team, Enterprise (not offered on Free)
claude.availabilityAndLimitations: Listed as an included capability on paid Individual (Pro, Max, Ultra) and Business (Team, Enterprise) plans; excluded on Free.

capabilities.featureName: Live Interactive UI, React & Diagram Previews (Artifacts vs Canvas)
capabilities.whatItDoes: Renders interactive HTML/CSS layouts, React components, SVG graphics, and diagrams directly inside the browser or desktop app.

chatgpt.requiredPlan: Free, Go, Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise
chatgpt.availabilityAndLimitations: Supports inline code editing, bug review comments, language porting, and HTML/React preview in Canvas.

claude.requiredPlan: Free, Pro, Max, Ultra, Team, Enterprise
claude.availabilityAndLimitations: Dedicated live preview window for React components, HTML/CSS prototypes, interactive SVGs, and Mermaid flowcharts across all plans.

capabilities.featureName: Agentic Terminal & Repository Coding (Claude Code vs Desktop IDE Context)
capabilities.whatItDoes: Reads local multi-file repositories, edits files, runs shell commands/tests, and manages Git workflows from your terminal or IDE.

chatgpt.productProvidedBy: ChatGPT Desktop App & OpenAI Platform API
chatgpt.requiredPlan: Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise (or separate API token billing)
chatgpt.availabilityAndLimitations: The ChatGPT desktop app can read active IDE panes on macOS/Windows, and OpenAI offers developer API tools, but consumer plans do not bundle a full terminal agent equivalent to Claude Code.

claude.productProvidedBy: Claude Code (Terminal CLI, VS Code, JetBrains, Desktop & Web)
claude.requiredPlan: Pro ($20/mo), Max ($100/mo), Ultra ($200/mo), Team (Standard & Premium seats), Enterprise, or Anthropic API
claude.availabilityAndLimitations: Included on all paid plans (excluded on Free). Both Team Standard ($20-$25/mo) and Premium ($100-$125/mo) seats include Claude Code; Premium seats provide 5x more usage for intensive coding.

capabilities.featureName: Sandboxed Cloud Code Execution & File Generation
capabilities.whatItDoes: Executes code inside a secure cloud sandbox to validate logic, transform files, and output downloadable artefacts.

chatgpt.requiredPlan: Free (limited), Go, Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise
chatgpt.availabilityAndLimitations: Runs stateful Python sessions capable of parsing uploaded archives, executing scripts, and generating downloadable files.

claude.productProvidedBy: Claude App (Create and edit files with code execution)
claude.requiredPlan: Free, Pro, Max, Ultra, Team, Enterprise
claude.availabilityAndLimitations: Official plan matrix confirms code execution to create and edit files across Free and all paid plans, alongside browser-side Artifact execution.

capabilities.featureName: Model Context Window Capacity (Long PDFs, Books & Repositories)
capabilities.whatItDoes: Defines the maximum volume of text, code, and documents that can be processed within a single conversation or API request.

chatgpt.productProvidedBy: OpenAI GPT Models (Consumer App & Platform API)
chatgpt.requiredPlan: Free, Go, Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise, API (varies by model and tier)
chatgpt.availabilityAndLimitations: Context window capacity scales by subscription tier and selected GPT reasoning or multimodal model, with expanded context on paid and API tiers.

claude.requiredPlan: Free, Pro, Max, Ultra, Team, Enterprise, API (model-dependent)
claude.availabilityAndLimitations: Model-dependent context window up to 1M tokens across Free, Pro, Max, Ultra, Team, Enterprise, and API (1M on current flagship models; 200K on select variants). Large prompts consume session quotas faster.

capabilities.featureName: Persistent Project Workspaces & Knowledge Folders (Projects)
capabilities.whatItDoes: Organises reference documents, custom instructions, and ongoing chats into dedicated project spaces.

chatgpt.requiredPlan: Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise (and rolling out to broader tiers per official docs)
chatgpt.availabilityAndLimitations: Groups chats, uploaded files, and custom instructions; shared team Projects are supported on ChatGPT Business and Enterprise.

claude.requiredPlan: Free (up to 5 Projects), Pro, Max, Ultra, Team, Enterprise (unlimited Projects)
claude.availabilityAndLimitations: Free tier includes up to 5 Projects; paid plans unlock unlimited Projects. Project sharing and team collaboration require Claude Team or Enterprise.

capabilities.featureName: Spreadsheet Cleaning, Quantitative Analysis & Interactive Dashboards
capabilities.whatItDoes: Processes uploaded CSV and Excel files to clean data, calculate metrics, and build visual charts or dashboards.

chatgpt.requiredPlan: Free (limited), Go, Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise
chatgpt.availabilityAndLimitations: Executes Python (pandas/matplotlib) directly on multi-sheet spreadsheets to clean rows, run regressions, and export modified Excel/CSV files.

claude.productProvidedBy: Claude App (Code Execution, Artifacts & Claude Dashboards beta)
claude.requiredPlan: Free, Pro, Max, Ultra, Team, Enterprise (Claude Dashboards beta requires Pro or higher)
claude.availabilityAndLimitations: Runs code execution on uploaded data files across all tiers and includes interactive Artifact visualisations plus Claude Dashboards (beta) on paid plans.

capabilities.featureName: Native Photorealistic Raster Image Generation & Editing (ChatGPT Images)
capabilities.whatItDoes: Creates original photorealistic images, illustrations, and rendered text-in-image graphics from prompts and edits selected regions.

chatgpt.requiredPlan: Free (limited daily quota), Go, Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise
chatgpt.availabilityAndLimitations: Built-in multimodal image generation and conversational inpainting directly inside ChatGPT chats.

claude.requiredPlan: Not applicable
claude.availabilityAndLimitations: Claude does not generate photorealistic raster images; visual output is focused on SVG vector graphics, code-driven charts, and Claude Design layouts.

capabilities.featureName: Multimodal Vision Input (Photos, UI Screenshots, Charts & PDFs)
capabilities.whatItDoes: Analyses uploaded images, diagrams, handwritten notes, and visual PDF pages to extract text, code, or structured insights.

chatgpt.requiredPlan: Free, Go, Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise, API
chatgpt.availabilityAndLimitations: Supports multi-image and document uploads across web, desktop, mobile camera, and API (subject to plan file-upload caps).

claude.productProvidedBy: Claude Multimodal Models (Opus, Sonnet, Haiku & Fable)
claude.requiredPlan: Free, Pro, Max, Ultra, Team, Enterprise, API
claude.availabilityAndLimitations: Inspects charts, UI screenshots, and full visual PDF layouts across all consumer and API tiers.

capabilities.featureName: Vector Graphics, UI Design & Motion Surfaces (Claude Design & Claude Motion beta)
capabilities.whatItDoes: Creates editable SVG diagrams, interactive visual prototypes, and motion graphics.

chatgpt.requiredPlan: Free, Go, Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise
chatgpt.availabilityAndLimitations: Can write raw SVG/HTML code in Canvas or export static charts via Python, without dedicated named Design or Motion surfaces inside ChatGPT.

claude.productProvidedBy: Claude App (Artifacts, Claude Design & Claude Motion beta)
claude.requiredPlan: Artifacts & Claude Design on Free+; Claude Motion (beta) on Team & Enterprise
claude.availabilityAndLimitations: Artifacts and Claude Design are available on all tiers; Claude Motion (beta) is listed on Team and Enterprise plans (not offered on Individual tiers).

capabilities.featureName: Real-Time Spoken Voice Mode
capabilities.whatItDoes: Allows hands-free, back-and-forth spoken conversations with the assistant across devices.

chatgpt.requiredPlan: Free (preview/daily limits), Go, Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise
chatgpt.availabilityAndLimitations: Supports low-latency interruption, expressive tone adjustments, and live camera/screen sharing on mobile apps.

claude.requiredPlan: Free, Pro, Max, Ultra, Team, Enterprise
claude.availabilityAndLimitations: Listed as available across all Individual and Team/Enterprise plans on Anthropic's official feature matrix; draws from standard session usage.

capabilities.featureName: App Connectors, Desktop Extensions & Browser/Office Add-ons
capabilities.whatItDoes: Connects the assistant to external cloud storage, productivity apps, web browsers, and local desktop tools.

chatgpt.productProvidedBy: ChatGPT App (Connectors, Custom GPT Actions & Desktop App)
chatgpt.requiredPlan: Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise (availability varies by connector)
chatgpt.availabilityAndLimitations: Includes cloud drive connectors (Google Drive, OneDrive/SharePoint), GitHub connectors, Custom GPT API Actions, and desktop app integrations.

claude.productProvidedBy: Claude App (Connectors, Desktop Extensions, Claude in Chrome & Microsoft 365)
claude.requiredPlan: Connectors, Skills & Desktop Extensions on Free+; Claude in Chrome, Microsoft 365 & Outlook on Pro+
claude.availabilityAndLimitations: Connectors and desktop extensions are available across all plans; Claude in Chrome, Claude for Microsoft 365, and Microsoft Outlook require Pro, Max, Ultra, Team, or Enterprise.

capabilities.featureName: Scheduled Tasks & Asynchronous Task Handoffs
capabilities.whatItDoes: Runs scheduled prompts, recurring briefings, or delegated background workflows automatically.

chatgpt.requiredPlan: Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise
chatgpt.availabilityAndLimitations: Supports recurring scheduled prompts and automated reminders with web and mobile notifications.

claude.productProvidedBy: Claude Subscription (Hand off and schedule tasks)
claude.requiredPlan: Pro, Max, Ultra, Team, Enterprise (not offered on Free)
claude.availabilityAndLimitations: Official plan matrix includes 'Hand off and schedule tasks' across Pro, Max, Ultra, Team, and Enterprise plans (excluded on Free).

capabilities.featureName: Developer APIs, Batch Processing, Prompt Caching & Subscription API Credits
capabilities.whatItDoes: Provides programmatic API access to underlying models with token-based billing and cost-optimisation controls.

chatgpt.requiredPlan: Pay-as-you-go token billing (separate from ChatGPT consumer subscriptions)
chatgpt.availabilityAndLimitations: Billed per million input/output tokens on platform.openai.com; consumer ChatGPT Plus and Pro plans do not include API token credits.

claude.requiredPlan: Pay-as-you-go token billing (plus monthly API credits on Max $100/mo, Ultra $200/mo, and Team up to $500/mo org pool)
claude.availabilityAndLimitations: Supports Prompt Caching and 50%-off Batch processing; Max ($100/mo), Ultra ($200/mo), and Team plans include monthly Claude Platform API credit allotments under current terms.

capabilities.featureName: Team Workspaces, Seat Minimums (2+ Seats) & Mixed Seat Tiers
capabilities.whatItDoes: Provides shared team workspaces, centralized billing, and role-appropriate seat tiers for organisations.

chatgpt.requiredPlan: Standard seat: $20 USD/user/mo billed annually or $25 USD/user/mo billed monthly (minimum 2 seats)
chatgpt.availabilityAndLimitations: Requires a minimum of 2 seats; includes shared Projects, internal Custom GPT publishing, admin console, and domain/SSO controls.

claude.requiredPlan: Minimum 2 seats (2–150 seats): Standard seat $20 USD/seat/mo annual ($25 monthly); Premium seat $100 USD/seat/mo annual ($125 monthly)
claude.availabilityAndLimitations: Admins can mix and match Standard and Premium seats (5x usage) in one workspace; both seat types include Claude Code and contribute to up to $500/mo in pooled API credits.

capabilities.featureName: AI Model Training Defaults & Temporary/Incognito Chat Privacy
capabilities.whatItDoes: Governs whether user prompts, uploaded documents, and code sessions are used to train public AI models.

chatgpt.requiredPlan: No training by default on Business, Enterprise & API; Opt-out & Temporary Chat on Free, Go, Plus & Pro
chatgpt.availabilityAndLimitations: Commercial and API data are excluded from training by default; consumer users can turn off 'Improve the model for everyone' in settings or use Temporary Chat.

claude.requiredPlan: None by default on Team, Enterprise & API; Opt-out & Incognito chats on Free, Pro, Max & Ultra
claude.availabilityAndLimitations: Official feature matrix confirms 'None by default' model training on Team and Enterprise, and 'Opt-out' plus Incognito chats on Free, Pro, Max, and Ultra.

capabilities.featureName: Enterprise Governance: SSO, SCIM, Audit Logs, Spend Controls & HIPAA
capabilities.whatItDoes: Enforces identity federation, automated user provisioning, audit logging, spend limits, and regulatory compliance.

chatgpt.requiredPlan: ChatGPT Business (SSO & admin console) and ChatGPT Enterprise (SCIM, audit logs, custom retention, HIPAA BAA)
chatgpt.availabilityAndLimitations: SCIM directory sync, granular role-based access, audit logs, and custom data retention require custom sales-assisted ChatGPT Enterprise contracts.

claude.requiredPlan: Team (SSO, domain verification, spend controls); Enterprise 20+ seats ($20/seat/mo annual + API usage or sales-assisted)
claude.availabilityAndLimitations: SSO and spend controls start on Team (2+ seats); SCIM, role-based access, audit logs, Compliance API, custom data retention, and HIPAA-ready offerings require Enterprise (20+ seats).

capabilities.featureName: Published UK GBP (£) Subscription Pricing Table
capabilities.whatItDoes: Displays official UK Pound Sterling (£ GBP) subscription rates directly on vendor documentation or checkout.

chatgpt.productProvidedBy: OpenAI Multi-Currency Billing (ChatGPT Plus, Pro & Business)
chatgpt.requiredPlan: Plus (£20 GBP/mo incl. VAT), Pro (£200 GBP/mo), Business
chatgpt.availabilityAndLimitations: OpenAI officially documents UK GBP web checkout pricing (£20/mo on Plus; £200/mo on Pro) including applicable VAT.

claude.requiredPlan: Pro ($20 USD/mo monthly or $17 USD/mo annual), Max ($100/mo), Ultra ($200/mo), Team ($20-$125/seat/mo)
claude.availabilityAndLimitations: Anthropic's public pricing page lists plans in USD (excluding applicable local tax/VAT); fixed UK GBP schedule is not published on the unauthenticated public pricing table.
